03 / Projects
Selected systems.
AI developer tooling, medical AI and real-time computer vision — three different problems, one systems mindset.
SYSTEM / 01

AIRemedy — AI Code Modernization & Security Remediation

An AI-powered developer enablement CLI that scans repositories for code-quality and security findings, uses an LLM for contextual remediation, generates structured patches, validates them in isolation, and keeps a human in control before changes are applied.

  • Python CLI workflow for scan, fix, migrate, serve, git and diagnostics
  • Deterministic scanning combined with LLM reasoning
  • Unified diff generation and isolated patch validation
  • Ruff, Semgrep, govulncheck, SARIF and CI integrations
  • Provider abstraction, allowlisted tools and explicit approval
PythonLLMsOpenAI APISecurityCLI
SYSTEM / 02

Diabetic Retinopathy Detection from Retinal Images

A retinal-image classification system comparing a custom CNN, MobileNetV2 and EfficientNetB0, with class-imbalance handling, transfer learning, fine-tuning, severity-focused evaluation and failure-case analysis.

  • 1,764 retinal fundus images with stratified data splits
  • Class weighting to emphasize severe retinopathy
  • Compared custom CNN, MobileNetV2 and EfficientNetB0
  • EfficientNetB0: 77.36% test accuracy and 82.5% Severe DR recall
  • Confusion matrices, macro F1, benchmarking and risk flagging
TensorFlowKerasEfficientNetB0MobileNetV2Medical AI
SYSTEM / 03

Drone Footage Object Detection & Tracking

An end-to-end aerial computer-vision pipeline using YOLOv8 on VisDrone, with annotation handling, evaluation, ByteTrack multi-object tracking and ONNX optimization for real-time inference.

  • 10 VisDrone object categories with custom data handling
  • 52.4% mAP@0.5 and 31.7% mAP@0.5:0.95
  • 67.8% recall for the Car class
  • ONNX export delivered a 1.6× FPS improvement
  • ByteTrack maintained persistent IDs across frames
YOLOv8PyTorchByteTrackONNXOpenCV
